name: Codex Meter
description:
Monitor and manage Codex usage limits.

- 5-hour and weekly Codex usage limits.
- Usage trends and limit-hit predictions.
- Banked reset redemption.
- Automatic redemption of banked resets before expiration.

Requieres Codex CLI or ChatGPT Desktop App logged in on the same machine. The extension reads your local auth credentials from `~/.codex/auth.json`.

Disclaimer: Not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.
